title: You Can Now Build Apps for Free With Google AI Studio (w/ Google Insider)
channel: Chris Koerner on The Koerner Office Podcast
promo_conflict: Google paid the host $0, but he disclosed that he is a Google shareholder and personal fan. The guest leads AI Studio and the Gemini API at Google DeepMind, so the discussion promotes products he works on.

stated_problem.quote: just have this idea and I want to build my first AI app or build my first app at all and, you know, share with a friend or someone in my family.
stated_problem.speaker: Logan Kilpatrick

idea.name: AI app development platform
idea.one_liner: Google offers builders AI tools and APIs to create and deploy AI apps, with charges when apps are deployed and served.
idea.customer: Developers, enterprises, and people who want to build their first app.
idea.offer: AI Studio and Gemini tools for prototyping and building AI-powered software.
idea.revenue_model: Free building with charges when deploying and serving users; exact pricing not stated.

key_quotes.quote: The beauty is you don't need to be an AI expert to go and like build AI products. You just need to have some problem that you're trying to solve
users inside of AI Studio were vibe coding literally tens of thousands of AI-powered apps using that new model

claims.claim: The guest says users built tens of thousands of AI-powered apps in AI Studio on launch day.
claims.quote: users inside of AI Studio were vibe coding literally tens of thousands of AI-powered apps using that new model

claims.claim: The guest says users could put an app into production in 90 seconds and build it for free.
claims.quote: deploying the thing into production and like putting in front of users in literally 90 seconds, and like the cost and barrier to entry is is literally free.

claims.claim: The guest says deployment and serving extra users incur charges, while building itself costs nothing.
claims.quote: It's paid when you deploy and you have to like, you know, service extra users and stuff, but to actually build the thing is doesn't cost anything

claims.claim: The guest estimates a person could build one AI app a day with about 30 minutes of work.
claims.quote: you actually could be building one AI app every day with like probably 30 minutes of work or something like that.

claims.claim: The guest says someone could spend $0 across the process of trying ideas until finding one they like.
claims.quote: you spend $0 in that whole process to get to the point where you like you actually built something that you're really excited about.

claims.claim: The host cites examples of three successful products reaching $100,000 a month; this is a second-hand anecdote.
claims.quote: the three that worked are now like, you know, $100,000 a month businesses or whatever.

ideas.delivery: Self-serve web development tools and APIs; builders create and deploy apps, then pay to serve users.

prices: Free to build; deployment and serving costs apply, amounts not stated

idea.offer: Personalized travel planning, transit guidance, and location-aware messages, including in a group chat.
